title: Validate Stack Sequences
statement: Given two integer arrays `pushed` and `popped` each with distinct values, return `YES` if this could have been the result of a sequence of push and pop operations on an initially empty stack, or `NO` otherwise.
constraints:
1 <= N = |pushed| = |popped| <= 1000
0 <= pushed[i], popped[i] <= 1000
All elements of pushed are distinct.
popped is a permutation of pushed.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers for the `pushed` array.
Line 3: N space-separated integers for the `popped` array.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
pushed = list(map(int, input().split()))
popped = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your stack simulation logic
